# Byma Solutions

> Byma Solutions is a web, mobile and UI/UX design studio in Nairobi, Kenya, founded in 2025. It builds React web applications, Flutter mobile apps for iOS and Android, and custom design systems for small and growing businesses across Kenya. Fixed-price website packages start at KSh 10,000.

## Key facts
- Location: Nairobi, Kenya (serves clients across Kenya)
- Founded: 2025
- Services: web development, mobile app development, UI/UX design
- Stack: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, TailwindCSS, Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Supabase, SQL, Figma
- Contact: WhatsApp +254 762 677 923 (https://wa.me/254762677923) or LinkedIn

## Website packages (one-time development fee)
- Digital Business Card — KSh 10,000: one-page site, mobile-optimized, WhatsApp/email click-to-chat, Google Maps. Ready in about 1 week. Domain (about KSh 1,000) paid by the client.
- Essential Growth — KSh 20,000: up to 4 pages, galleries or pricing tables, quote forms, basic on-page SEO. Ready in 2–3 weeks.
- Smart Business System — KSh 35,000: 5+ pages with a secure cloud database, booking or sign-up management, M-Pesa integration, 14 days of post-launch support. Ready in 3–5 weeks.
- Enterprise: custom architecture, Supabase engineering, API integrations (M-Pesa, CRM), advanced SEO and a formal SLA. Quoted individually.

## Maintenance plans (monthly)
- Basic Care Plan — KSh 2,500/month: security checks, backups, small content updates, hosting monitoring.
- Growth Support Plan — KSh 5,000/month: everything in Basic Care, up to 2 hours of development time per month, priority support with a 24-hour response time.

## Selected projects
- [Salio](https://app.salio.co.ke): Offline-first point-of-sale system for small retailers with unreliable internet; syncs sales and inventory when back online.
- [Wincer Cake House](https://wincer-project.vercel.app): Full-stack e-commerce and content platform for a bakery, with checkout and an admin dashboard for inventory and sales.
- [Law Firm Design](https://sweet-art-one.vercel.app): Multi-page site design for a corporate and litigation law firm in Nairobi.
- [Bakery Design](https://frenchmaid-bakery.vercel.app): Multi-page e-commerce and marketing site for a family-run French bakery in Nairobi, built with React and Tailwind CSS.
- Driving School Design: Editorial-style site for California Driving School in Eastleigh, Nairobi.
